column2: FixedSizeBitVectors: bvmul s t is unsigned multiplication modulo 2^m, bvshl s t is s * 2^(bv2nat t) modulo 2^m: so x * 2^k = x << k (k < m)
FixedSizeBitVectors: bvmul by a constant that is not a power of two has no shift form
FixedSizeBitVectors: bvadd, bvsub, bvmul are arithmetic modulo 2^m, so ((extract i 0) of the result) = the same operation on the (extract i 0) of the operands
FixedSizeBitVectors: (bvurem s t) = s - (bvudiv s t) * t modulo 2^m for t != 0, and s for t = 0 (the SMT-LIB total definition of bvudiv by 0 = all ones)

FixedSizeBitVectors: zero_extend i (bvadd (zero_extend j s) c) equals zero_extend (i+j) (bvadd...) at the wider width iff s + c < 2^(m+j) cannot wrap; constants c >= 2^(m+j) can wrap and stay as they are
